owner.name: James King
owner.education: B.S. in Business, Shepherd University; Catoctin High School Class of 2014
owner.bio: James King is the owner-operator of a small contracting business serving Frederick County, Maryland and the surrounding area. He holds a business degree from Shepherd University, where he also played Division II football, and has nearly two years of crew-management experience leading painting teams at Cochran & Mann before starting his own operation.

business.name: James King Contracting
services: small home repairs and handyman work
business.description: A small owner-operated contracting business providing landscaping, painting, junk removal, and handyman services to homeowners, realtors, and repeat residential clients in Frederick County, Maryland. Work comes primarily through word of mouth, realtor referrals, and repeat customers.
business.growth_plan: Purchase additional equipment (trailer, commercial mower, sprayer rig), formalize the business entity (LLC), invest in bonding/insurance to qualify for larger commercial and government contracts, and eventually hire 1-2 crew members.
typical_use_of_funds: Equipment: trailer, commercial-grade mower, paint sprayer, hauling equipment
Business formation and licensing costs (LLC, MHIC home improvement license)
Insurance and bonding to qualify for commercial/government work
Marketing: website, vehicle wrap, local advertising
Working capital to hire seasonal crew members

eligible_applicant_types: for-profit organizations other than small businesses
